Hi team,

Quick intro — Kimberly from Redwood Inference (partner programs). We're kicking off an integration and marketplace syndication that needs coordinated SKU mapping, listing requirements, and a short mutual action plan so we can ship the connector and cross-list in both marketplaces (Grafana and Datadog).

Goals for the next 3 weeks:
- Agree SKU mapping and commercial labels (free/trial/paid tiers)
- Confirm marketplace technical checklist for Grafana and Datadog
- Draft mutual action plan with owners and go/no-go dates

I've attached an initial SKU mapping workbook and an MAP draft. Can Datadog and Grafana indicate the preferred contact for marketplace onboarding and any blockers around billing/sales attribution? Also looping in SigmaOps (external consultancy) who will help with packaging and packaging docs.

Attachments: redwood-gf-datadog-sku-mapping.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-v1.docx

Thanks — happy to run a 30-min sync if helpful.

—Kim

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the note — I'm Maya on Datadog Partnerships. Quick answers:
- Preferred contact for Datadog listing: partnerships-engineering@datadog.com (cc'ing our engineer in the thread).
- Billing attribution: Datadog supports reseller and referral models; we'll need a short commercial terms summary from Redwood to confirm attribution flow.
- Marketplace checklist: see our public vender onboarding doc (link below) — primary blockers are terms-of-service & security questionnaire completion.

We reviewed the attached SKU workbook and had a few questions on tokenization of tiers (your "Pro": is that usage-based or seat-based?). Could Ben or Karthik share how Redwood intends to bill partners?

Happy to join a sync tomorrow afternoon (2:00–4:00 PDT) if that works.

Related link: https://www.datadog.com/marketplace/onboarding

Best,

Hi Kimberly and Maya,

Thanks for looping us in. I'm Tomas from Grafana Marketplace. A few quick notes:
- Listing contact: marketplace-ops@grafana.com (we handle packaging and legal triage).
- Grafana wants a single bundle artifact (OCI/zip) and a small README describing integrations, plus a signed security checklist (we can provide the template).
- For SKU naming we prefer human-friendly canonical names (e.g., "Redwood Connector for Grafana — Team") and an internal SKU code (we can assign).

We reviewed the ledger you shared — small ask: include a mapping column for "Marketplace SKU" so we can pre-assign codes.

We can join the sync with Datadog tomorrow; 3:00 PM PDT works on our side.

Thanks,

The attached workbook has a proposed mapping column for marketplace SKUs.

Security: Karthik will run point on the security questionnaire and provide the SOC/Security pack. Karthik, can you confirm the ETA for the security bundle?

Packaging: SigmaOps (cc'd separately) will produce the initial bundle. Laura — can your team help prioritize the Grafana marketplace artifact review?

- 4/12 15:00 PDT joint sync (Datadog + Grafana + Redwood + SigmaOps) — confirm attendees
- Datadog to confirm attribution/terms owner
- Karthik to share security pack by EOD 4/13
- I'll update the MAP (attached) with dates and owners after the sync
